crossRefs.note: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.
Now David was old and full of days; and he made Solomon his son king over Israel.
The time that he reigned over Israel was forty years; he reigned seven years in Hebron, and he reigned thirty-three…
He died at a good old age, full of days, riches, and honor; and Solomon his son reigned in his place.
The days of our years are seventy, or even by reason of strength eighty years; yet their pride is but labor and sorrow…
Now Abraham and Sarah were old, well advanced in age. Sarah had passed the age of childbearing.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: Now king David was old and advanced in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he couldn’t keep warm.
translations.bsb: Now King David was old and well along in years, and though they covered him with blankets, he could not keep warm.
translations.kjv: Now king David was old and stricken in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he gat no heat.
